card.name: The word first in pass and trimester
card.fires_on: The word "first" in pharmacology phrases like first-pass metabolism and first trimester of pregnancy. It also fires on words about prolonged gestation or pregnancy.

modes.label: First-pass metabolism
modes.description: "first" right before "pass" when describing liver or gut metabolism of a drug.
modes.example: which could decrease<< first>>-pass metabolism of nimodipine.

modes.label: First trimester or first days
modes.description: "first" before a pregnancy or lactation time span such as trimester or days.
modes.example: exposure that has been limited to the<< first>> trimester.

modes.label: Prolonged gestation
modes.description: "prolonged" or "prolongs" describing pregnancy length in animal studies.
modes.example: were associated with dystocia,<< prolonged>> gestation, reduced fetal weights

card.plain: It marks the word "first" when a label talks about first-pass metabolism or the first trimester, and also words about lengthened pregnancy.
